x: Also competing was Malcolm Dodds in his first race over one mile and he comfortably broke the fifty minutes. Joe Scammell was also a welcome starter who must have walked the race a few times.
'What's that?' Bels other Youth competing was Malcolm Dodds, who in his first ever 7 mile race did no discredit to himself.

These two lads have got a promising future if they can retain their ambition and allow it to come steadily. In the Youth's 3 miles we again had two starters, Stuart Bennett and Malcolm Dodds. They produced good efforts for 6th and 7th positions.
